## Yateveo Man-Eater (CR 9)

The mass of rotting foliage and vines drags itself forward, a great rotting maw opening to release a noxious gas.  

**XP** 6,400  
NE Large plant  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft; all-around vision; Perception +19  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+10 natural, +1 Dex, -1 size)  
**hp** 111 (11d8 + 55)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +5, **Will** +8  
**DR** 10/magic; **Immune** plant-traits, acid, poison and disease  


**Offense**


**Speed** 15 ft., climb 15 ft.  
**Melee** bite +13 (2d6+ 9 plus grab and bad breath), 2 slams +12 (1d8+ 9)  
**Ranged** digestive acid +8 (4d6 acid plus bad breath)  
**Space/Reach** 10 ft./10 ft. (15 ft with slam)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (30-ft cone, 5d6 acid damage plus bad breath, Reflex DC 19 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), bad breath, digestive acid, swallow whole; poison  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 12, **Con** 19, **Int** 6, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +14; **CMD** 24 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Defensive Combat Training, Improved Natural Attack (Bite), Improved Natural Attack (Slam), Horrific Gorging, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Perception +18  


**Special Abilities**


**Bad Breath (Ex)** The yateveo’s breath is sickeningly bad and can easily incapacitate an unprepared fighter. The yateveo’s bite and digestive acid attack make the target sickened for 1 minute (Fortitude DC 19 negates). Any targets that are sickened from bad breath are also exposed to the yateveo’s poison. If a target is already sickened, this effect increases to nauseated. The yateveo can use their bad breath as a breath attack, dealing 5d6 acid damage in a 30-ft cone. The saving throw is Constitution-based and the damage dealt by the breath weapon is 1d6 per 2 HD.  

**Digestive Acid (Ex)** As a standard action, the yateveo can spit a blast of acidic digestive acids at a target within 30 feet, dealing their bad breath damage and activating bad breath.  

**Poison (Ex)** **Type** injury; save Fortitude DC 19; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Strength damage and 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm forests, jungles, and swamps  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
